headline: Clinton executive order directed federal agencies to take a leading role in global efforts to control and prevent tobacco use.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order set federal policy on how US agencies should address tobacco control and prevention around the world. No summary was provided, so the specific instructions to agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies working on international health and trade
who_it_affects.how: The title suggests these agencies were directed to support global tobacco control and prevention efforts.
